277704049.description:
Mixed Mineral Collection
Amethyst Points, Calcite Specimen, and Assorted Raw Stones
9" x 5" x 7"
Natural Specimens
This comprehensive collection of natural geological specimens features a diverse range of colors and crystalline structures. The lot is highlighted by twenty-one amethyst points, each displaying a characteristic transition from a raw quartz base to a violet-hued termination. Also included is a substantial amber-toned calcite specimen, noted for its translucency and prominent crystalline planes. A bulk assortment of smaller raw and tumbled stones completes the set, offering a variety of textures and earth-toned hues for display or study.
21 Individual amethyst crystal points showing natural violet coloration
One large honey-colored calcite specimen with distinct geometric cleavage
Varied pile of assorted raw minerals including rose quartz and aventurine
4 lbs total lot weight for all included pieces
Condition:
Very good overall condition. As natural specimens, all pieces exhibit inherent inclusions, fractures, and irregular surfaces characteristic of raw minerals. The amethyst points maintain their natural terminations, and the large calcite piece is structurally sound with well-defined crystalline facets.
